datasets.name: job_usage
datasets.displayName: Job Usage by Run, Day and SKU

config.source:
WITH bounds AS (
  -- Hard cap: never more than 30 days, never past today
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(date_range.min, date_sub(current_date(), 29)), date_sub(LEAST(COALESCE(date_range.max, current_date()), current_date()), 29)) AS start_date, LEAST(COALESCE(date_range.max, current_date()), current_date()) AS end_date
),
usage_priced AS (
  SELECT
    u.workspace_id,
    u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id,
    u.usage_metadata.job_run_id AS run_id,
    u.usage_date,
    u.sku_name,
    u.billing_origin_product,
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as,
    COALESCE(size(map_filter(u.custom_tags, (k, v) -> k NOT IN ('Vendor', 'Creator', 'ClusterName', 'ClusterId', 'JobId', 'RunName', 'DatabricksInstancePoolId', 'DatabricksInstancePoolCreatorId', 'DatabricksInstanceGroupId'))) > 0, false) AS has_custom_tags,
    u.usage_quantity AS dbus,
    u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.default AS list_cost
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
   AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
   AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
   AND (u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL)
  WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN b.start_date AND b.end_date
    AND (u.billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' OR (u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL))
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_date, sku_name, billing_origin_product,
    first(run_as, true) AS run_as,
    bool_or(has_custom_tags) AS has_custom_tags,
    SUM(dbus) AS dbus,
    SUM(list_cost) AS list_cost
  FROM usage_priced
  GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id, usage_date, sku_name, billing_origin_product
),
runs AS (
  -- A long run spans several hourly rows; the outcome is on the last one
  SELECT
    t.workspace_id, t.job_id, t.run_id,
    MIN(t.period_start_time) AS run_start,
    MAX(t.period_end_time) AS run_end,
    MAX(t.result_state) AS result_state,
    MAX(t.termination_code) AS termination_code
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE t.period_start_time >= date_sub(b.start_date, 7)
  GROUP BY t.workspace_id, t.job_id, t.run_id
),
run_stats AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id, job_id, run_id, run_total_cost,
    percentile_approx(run_total_cost, 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id) AS job_median_run_cost,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id) AS job_run_count
  FROM (
    SELECT workspace_id, job_id, run_id, SUM(list_cost) AS run_total_cost
    FROM daily
    WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id
  )
),
jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name AS job_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
workspaces AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT
    d.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(w.workspace_name, CAST(d.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,
    d.job_id,
    COALESCE(j.job_name, CONCAT('Job ', d.job_id)) AS job_name,
    d.run_id,
    CONCAT(d.workspace_id, ':', d.run_id) AS run_key,
    CONCAT(d.workspace_id, ':', d.job_id) AS job_key,
    d.run_as,
    d.usage_date,
    d.sku_name,
    d.billing_origin_product,
    d.has_custom_tags,
    d.dbus,
    d.list_cost,
    r.result_state,
    r.termination_code,
    r.run_start,
    r.run_end,
    ROUND((unix_timestamp(r.run_end) - unix_timestamp(r.run_start)) / 60.0, 1) AS run_duration_min,
    CASE
      WHEN d.run_id IS NULL THEN 'No run ID'
      WHEN r.result_state IS NULL THEN 'Running / unknown'
      WHEN r.result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT') THEN 'Failed'
      WHEN r.result_state = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'Cancelled'
      WHEN r.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'Succeeded'
      ELSE initcap(r.result_state)
    END AS run_outcome,
    s.run_total_cost,
    s.job_median_run_cost,
    COALESCE(s.job_run_count >= 5 AND s.run_total_cost > 2 * s.job_median_run_cost, false) AS is_anomalous_run
  FROM daily d
  LEFT JOIN runs r ON d.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND d.job_id = r.job_id AND d.run_id = r.run_id
  LEFT JOIN run_stats s ON d.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND d.job_id = s.job_id AND d.run_id = s.run_id
  LEFT JOIN jobs_latest j ON d.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND d.job_id = j.job_id
  LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON d.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
)
SELECT
  e.*,
  CASE WHEN e.run_outcome = 'Failed' THEN e.list_cost ELSE 0 END AS failed_cost,
  CASE WHEN e.run_outcome = 'Failed' THEN e.run_key END AS failed_run_key,
  CASE WHEN e.run_outcome = 'Cancelled' THEN e.list_cost ELSE 0 END AS cancelled_cost,
  CASE WHEN e.run_outcome = 'Succeeded' THEN e.list_cost ELSE 0 END AS succeeded_cost,
  CASE WHEN e.run_outcome = 'Succeeded' THEN e.run_key END AS succeeded_run_key,
  CASE WHEN e.is_anomalous_run THEN e.run_key END AS anomalous_run_key,
  CASE WHEN e.has_custom_tags THEN 0 ELSE e.list_cost END AS untagged_cost,
  b.start_date AS effective_start,
  b.end_date AS effective_end
FROM enriched e
CROSS JOIN bounds b

WITH bounds AS (
  -- Hard cap: never more than 30 days, never past today
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(date_range.min, date_sub(current_date(), 29)), date_sub(LEAST(COALESCE(date_range.max, current_date()), current_date()), 29)) AS start_date, LEAST(COALESCE(date_range.max, current_date()), current_date()) AS end_date
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT
    u.workspace_id,
    u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id,
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as,
    u.usage_date,
    to_json(map_filter(u.custom_tags, (k, v) -> k NOT IN ('Vendor', 'Creator', 'ClusterName', 'ClusterId', 'JobId', 'RunName', 'DatabricksInstancePoolId', 'DatabricksInstancePoolCreatorId', 'DatabricksInstanceGroupId'))) AS tags_json,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.default) AS list_cost
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
   AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
   AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
   AND (u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL)
  WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN b.start_date AND b.end_date
    AND (u.billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' OR (u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL))
  GROUP BY ALL
),
tagged_maps AS (
  SELECT *, from_json(tags_json, 'map<string,string>') AS tags FROM tagged
),
tag_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT k AS tag_key
  FROM tagged_maps LATERAL VIEW explode(map_keys(tags)) x AS k
),
jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name AS job_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
workspaces AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest
)
SELECT
  d.workspace_id,
  COALESCE(w.workspace_name, CAST(d.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,
  d.job_id,
  COALESCE(j.job_name, CONCAT('Job ', d.job_id)) AS job_name,
  d.run_as,
  d.usage_date,
  k.tag_key,
  COALESCE(try_element_at(d.tags, k.tag_key), '(not set)') AS tag_value,
  d.list_cost,
  CASE WHEN try_element_at(d.tags, k.tag_key) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE d.list_cost END AS tagged_cost
FROM tagged_maps d
CROSS JOIN tag_keys k
LEFT JOIN jobs_latest j ON d.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND d.job_id = j.job_id
LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON d.workspace_id = w.workspace_id

WITH bounds AS (
  -- Hard cap: never more than 30 days, never past today
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(date_range.min, date_sub(current_date(), 29)), date_sub(LEAST(COALESCE(date_range.max, current_date()), current_date()), 29)) AS start_date, LEAST(COALESCE(date_range.max, current_date()), current_date()) AS end_date
),
workspaces AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest
)
SELECT
  d.workspace_id,
  COALESCE(w.workspace_name, CAST(d.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,
  d.usage_date,
  d.billing_origin_product,
  d.sku_name,
  d.total_usage,
  d.total_cost
FROM (
  SELECT
    u.workspace_id,
    u.usage_date,
    u.billing_origin_product,
    u.sku_name,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_usage,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.default) AS total_cost
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  INNER JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
   AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
   AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
   AND (u.usage_end_time <= lp.price_end_time OR lp.price_end_time IS NULL)
  WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN b.start_date AND b.end_date
  GROUP BY ALL
) d
LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON d.workspace_id = w.workspace_id

lines: List-price DBU cost of jobs. The date range is capped at 30 days: a longer selection shows the last 30 days of it. Click a job in the tables to focus every widget on this page on that job.

frame.title: Total Job Cost
frame.description: List-price cost of job compute and job-run SQL warehouse usage.
